Become the heartbeat of our production! As a maintainer (f/m/div.), your mission is to keep our facilities running. Together as a team you try not only to repair the plants, but also to solve preventive problems. Your tasks essentially include: - You assume responsibility for the maintenance and maintenance of our machine park. Whether a mechanical problem or an electrical challenge - you find the cause and solve it sustainably - With an analytical sense, you show potential for improvement and implement it - On predefined days (twice a year) you work with the whole team on investment audits and self-responsible pikettdienst (4-5 weekends a year)
